q: What goes into the CBAM figure for aluminium from Mozal?
title: Mozal aluminium: the CBAM figure
short: Only direct emissions count: anode carbon, perfluorocarbons from anode effects, and fuel for casting and anode baking. Power comes under a supply contract through the regional grid and is reported, not charged. Check the plant's current operating status, as its power supply has been under review.
audience: Traders and EU buyers of primary aluminium from the Mozal smelter near Maputo

ul: Anode consumption per tonne of metal.
Gas or fuel for casting and anode baking.

p: Report kWh per tonne and the factor for the power actually supplied, from the contract or the supplier. Do not assume a national grid factor for a dedicated supply.
Report by period operated. If production stops or restarts, say so.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.

sources.label: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
